verdict.rationale: YYLO's evidence describes a CLI-based agent orchestrator built for developers and project operators (npm install, `yy init --task`, git worktrees, merge/validation flows) with no mention of mockup/design ingestion, visual-to-code translation, or any PM-facing no-code interface; usage requires CLI commands and Git literacy, the opposite of an engineering-handoff-free workflow for non-technical PMs.
